definitions.explanation: The biological system consisting of the brain, spinal cord, and nerves, which transmits signals throughout the body and coordinates sensation, movement, and thought.

examples.japanese: {神経系|しんけいけい}の{病気|びょうき}。
examples.english: A disease of the nervous system.

examples.japanese: {神経系|しんけいけい}は{脳|のう}と{脊髄|せきずい}を{中心|ちゅうしん}とする。
examples.english: The nervous system is centered on the brain and spinal cord.

examples.japanese: ストレスは{神経系|しんけいけい}に{大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: Stress has a major effect on the nervous system.

examples.japanese: {神経系|しんけいけい}は{中枢|ちゅうすう}{神経|しんけい}と{末梢|まっしょう}{神経|しんけい}の{二|ふた}つに{大|おお}きく{分|わ}けられる。
examples.english: The nervous system is broadly divided into the central and peripheral nervous systems.

notes:
Composed of {神経|しんけい} (nerve) and {系|けい} (system). A standard biological/medical term, used in both technical writing and general educated conversation.

USAGE:
- Used as a plain noun, most often with の in attributive position: {神経系|しんけいけい}の{病気|びょうき}.
- Regularly compounded with other terms: {中枢|ちゅうすう}{神経系|しんけいけい} (central nervous system), {自律|じりつ}{神経系|しんけいけい} (autonomic nervous system).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神経系|しんけいけい}の{疾患|しっかん}: nervous system disorder
- {神経系|しんけいけい}に{作用|さよう}する: to act on the nervous system
- {神経系|しんけいけい}が{発達|はったつ}する: the nervous system develops
- {神経系|しんけいけい}の{異常|いじょう}: abnormality in the nervous system

RELATED TERMS:
- {中枢|ちゅうすう}{神経|しんけい}: central nerves / central nervous system — brain and spinal cord
- {末梢|まっしょう}{神経|しんけい}: peripheral nerves — nerves outside the brain and spinal cord
- {自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい}: autonomic nerves — regulate involuntary functions
- {脳|のう}: brain — main command center of the nervous system
